JCE.evidence: 27/27 shared vectors agree between Rust and the independent Node reference

JBC.evidence: one equivalent-output digest workload is measured; the full benchmark matrix is not implemented

JAD.evidence: offline read-only repository inspection and synthetic adoption receipt

JIA.evidence: typed instruction authority resolution and allowlisted discovery on one host

JGM.evidence: deterministic logical guardian gate; no machine or operator independence

JSH.evidence: semantic identity and atomic flat-graph patches; no compiler AST

JNODE.evidence: offline CLI self-check, repository inspection, conformance and simulation commands

JDR.evidence: current source-bound test executes 10,000 cases at seed 144; prior 30,000-case runs are historical and not machine-bound; JDR2 effect authority is not implemented

JME.evidence: mock ledger only; no real payment, custody, marketplace or transaction

independence.scope: Rust and Node JCE1 implementations use separate code paths on the same Mac and operator account
limitations: No hostile process, host, key or operator independence is demonstrated
JDR1 adjudicators remain I0 logical components

claims: No public conformance level is claimed before official release and external verification
No blockchain consensus, payment network or distributed JOAN node is implemented
No universal performance, security, adjudication or adoption superiority is claimed
JCE0 remains a historical custom profile; JCE1 is additive
